evidence.quote: Google Ads API also uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
a developer token is also required to make Google Ads API calls
Enable Google Ads API in your Google Cloud project to automatically be granted Test access for your project.
a detailed manual audit of your application
The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST.
Google may automatically upgrade your project's API access level to Basic once you submit your application.

result.notes: Test access (sandbox-like, test accounts only) is granted automatically/free upon enabling the API and OAuth2 client + developer token. Real production use requires applying for Basic access (auto-upgrade after brand verification) or Standard access, which needs a manual Google audit (~10 business days) — this gates broad/unlimited production use, hence admin_approval/app_review rather than pure self-serve. No official Google-published MCP server found; only third-party/community MCP servers exist (e.g. gomarble-ai, amekala). Auth requires both OAuth2 (user/service account) and a developer token (acts as an API-key-like credential) on every call.
result.one_liner: Google Ads API is Google's programmatic (REST/gRPC) interface for managing Google Ads accounts, campaigns, and reporting.
